channel.title: Behold the Lamb Presents
channel.desc: In a world filled with compromise, confusion, and counterfeit Christianity, true believers in Christ are being scrutinized like never before-especially in the United States. This timely message uncovers the prophetic reality that God's faithful people will be closely observed by the world, and that our response to truth and conviction can powerfully witness for Christ. Are you ready to be tested as a peculiar person, a member of the royal priesthood, a keeper of God's holy commandments?
